objective: Implement event grouping logic to merge consecutive technical noise events and group events by cycle ID for event log views.

acceptance.criterion: extractCycleId reads cycle_id from metadata top-level or metadata.dosing_data, returning null if not found.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test verifies cycle_id extraction from both paths in eventGrouping.test.ts

acceptance.criterion: filterEventsBySearch filters system events case-insensitively across title, message, category, and reason.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test verifies search filtering matching title and message in eventGrouping.test.ts

acceptance.criterion: buildLogRows in important mode merges consecutive technical info logs with identical title and category, preserving warnings/errors and grouping cycles.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test checks merged rows and cycle grouping in important mode in eventGrouping.test.ts

acceptance.criterion: buildLogRows in all_technical mode preserves individual technical events while still grouping cycle events by cycle_id.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test checks unmerged technical events and cycle grouping in all_technical mode in eventGrouping.test.ts
